login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Admin Login

two_factor.sent: We sent a verification code. Enter it to finish signing in.
two_factor.sent_app: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to finish signing in.
two_factor.backup_hint: If you cannot use your phone, enter a backup code instead.
two_factor.resent: We sent a new verification code. Enter the new code.

login.locked_permanent: Reset your password or contact an administrator to unlock the account.

error.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.

password_change.title: Please set a new password
password_change.reason_expired: Your password has expired (on {{date}}). Change it to a new password to log in.
password_change.reason_remind: Your password has expired (on {{date}}). Change it now, or choose "Change later" to be reminded again in {{days}} days.
password_change.reason_remind_one: Your password has expired (on {{date}}). Change it now, or choose "Change later" to be reminded again in {{days}} day.
password_change.reason_admin_assigned: You logged in with a password set by an administrator. Change it to a new password only you know to log in.
password_change.changed_toast: Your password has been changed. You have been logged out on other devices.
password_change.postponed_toast: Password change postponed. We will ask again on {{date}}.
password_change.restart_required: The password change step has timed out. Please log in again from the start.

forgot_password.title: Forgot Password
forgot_password.subtitle: Enter the email address you used to sign up and we'll send you a password reset link.
forgot_password.success: A password reset link has been sent to your email.

reset_password.title: Reset Password
reset_password.subtitle: Please enter your new password.
reset_password.success: Your password has been changed successfully.
reset_password.invalid_token: The password reset link has expired or is invalid.

session_expired_toast: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
dormancy_restored: Your account is no longer dormant. Welcome back.

password_rules.char_types: · 2 or more of letters, numbers and special characters
password_rules.identifier: · must not contain the user ID (email local part)
password_rules.repeated: · no character repeated {{count}} or more times
password_rules.sequential: · no sequence like 1234 or abcd of {{count}} or more characters
password_rules.reuse: · not one of your last {{count}} passwords
password_rules.not_current: · must differ from your current password
